text: The most powerful man in AI just admitted an affair. And this isn't just gossip.
The CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, told his staff he was unfaithful to his wife.
Reports say the woman was being watched by US intelligence over ties to China. She hasn't been charged.
Nvidia's board opened an investigation, and says it has no reason to believe any secrets leaked.
So why is the whole AI world watching?
Because Nvidia makes most of the chips that power today's AI. It's worth about four and a half trillion dollars.
On Monday, the stock fell about five percent.
Next week, Nvidia reports earnings. The day after, Congress wants answers.
every AI company built on its chips feels it.
So, should he stay as CEO? Comment below.
